verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents a lightweight CLI tool, 'honeymarker', for CRUD operations on markers via command line, which counts as an official CLI but is narrowly scoped (only marker management) rather than a general-purpose CLI for datasets, queries, triggers, or SLOs. Missing for 10: a comprehensive official CLI covering broader product operations (datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs) and any independent/hands-on validation of its use in AI-native automation workflows.
